description.p: Nexum combines chemical calculations, molecular visualization, experimental data analysis, quality tools, uncertainty models and scientific reports in a desktop workbench.
The application documents model assumptions and limitations alongside results and keeps original imported data separate from processed series.
The application interface is currently available in Brazilian Portuguese.
O Nexum reúne cálculos químicos, visualização molecular, análise de dados experimentais, qualidade, modelos de incerteza e relatórios científicos em uma bancada desktop.
O aplicativo apresenta hipóteses e limitações dos modelos junto dos resultados e mantém os dados importados originais separados das séries processadas.
Stable 7.0 release with the integrated laboratory, molecular workspace, data workflows, uncertainty tools and verified native packaging.
Application-wide appearance preference, synchronized molecular views and clearer session controls.
Integrated laboratory, uncertainty and speciation tools, portable projects and macOS packaging preparation.
